title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p6n9: lichen_tdma_init declaration/definition mismatch — header updated, .c body stale
description:
**File:**  vs 

**Problem:** The commit fixes the header declaration to  but does **not** update the corresponding C implementation body in . The implementation still has the old signature  and its body only initializes slot-level fields (uid=1000(ec2-user) gid=1000(ec2-user) groups=1000(ec2-user),4(adm),10(wheel),190(systemd-journal) context=unconfined_u:unconfined_r:unconfined_t:s0-s0:c0.c1023, , ) rather than the  fields expected by callers (slot, n_slots, superframe, slot_duration, synced as used in ).

This is a compilation error (declaration/definition mismatch) and a logic error (wrong init). The .c file needs to be updated to match.
